scope.description: The distributed Browserify bundle has numbered modules and require maps but no source map or embedded package version identifiers. The object-hash package license is verified locally; embedded third-party license completeness is not established.
limitations: Require maps identify buffer, base64-js, ieee754, crypto (historical crypto-browserify layout), and a process shim under internal key lYpoI2. Exact dependency versions and historical copyright/license texts remain unverified.
The MJML manifest includes verified licenses for newer browser polyfill releases. Those entries do not establish the versions or historical license notices for this separate prebundle.
